name: lokalbot
description: Recall meetings, decisions, and commitments from your Mac's LokalBot library, with source references.

interface.longDescription: Search recorded meetings, read summaries and selected transcript excerpts, review commitments, and prepare for conversations. The library stays on your Mac; requested results are shared with your connected ChatGPT or Codex client. Requires LokalBot and its meeting-library permission.
defaultPrompt: Find the meeting where we decided on the caching approach.
What commitments are still open from my recent meetings?
Help me prepare for my next conversation with a colleague.
